versions.title: Unit Leave Management System
versions.subtitle: High-level overview of system purpose, role workflows, and core architecture.
versions.purpose: The Unit Leave Management System provides a streamlined, non-intrusive notification portal for personnel to log planned leave. Adjutants and Unit Leadership use the portal to maintain real-time threat board awareness and monitor unit readiness without requiring formal permission workflows.

sections.title: Portal Structure & Key Features
sections.description: The system is divided into three primary portals accessible via the top navigation bar:

screenshotPlaceholder.title: System Navigation Bar & Top Header
screenshotPlaceholder.description: Screenshot showing the top navigation bar with Unit Emblem, Apply for Leave tab, Adjutant tab, Admin tab, Help trigger, and Dark Mode toggle.

fields.name: Apply for Leave
fields.purpose: Public submission portal for all cadets and staff to log planned leave.

fields.name: Adjutant Portal
fields.purpose: Operational dashboard showing 6-week Gantt status grid, active/past leave lists, and parade days affected per member.

fields.name: Admin Portal
fields.purpose: Member roster management, system settings (including Unit Name & Parade Night settings), security IP whitelist rules, and audit logging.

sections.title: No-Permission Voluntary Notification Workflow
sections.description: Because the Unit is a volunteer organization, personnel log leave as a notification rather than requesting permission. All submissions immediately register on the Adjutant Status Grid.

bestPractices: Log leave notifications as far in advance as possible to give Adjutants clear parade readiness visibility.
Ensure rank and surname match your official roster record.
For parade nights, use the 'This Parade Night' or 'Next Parade Night' quick shortcut buttons for fast 1-click date population.

versions.title: Apply for Leave Page Guide
versions.subtitle: How personnel log upcoming or past leave notifications for the Unit.
versions.purpose: This page provides the main entry point for cadets, staff, and officers to notify the unit of upcoming leave, training conflicts, or personal absences.

sections.title: Screen Overview
sections.description: The page consists of a header banner and the primary Leave Notification Form panel. Submissions are processed in real-time. Once a member submits a Leave Form, all staff who have opted in will receive a notification via their chosen email address.

screenshotPlaceholder.title: Log Leave Notification Form Interface
screenshotPlaceholder.description: Form layout showing Rank dropdown, Surname text box, Date Pickers, Quick Presets, Reason selector, and Submit button.

sections.title: Quick Parade Shortcuts
sections.description: Below the date inputs, quick action buttons allow instant 1-click selection of 'This Parade Night' or 'Next Parade Night' parade dates, as well as +1 Day, +3 Days, and +7 Days duration extenders.

bestPractices: Select accurate dates so Parade Night counts are correctly calculated.
If taking leave for a single parade night, set both Start Date and End Date to that Parade Night date.
Leave forms aren't just for Parade Nights. If you applied to attend an activity and can no longer come, you must also submit a Leave notice.

versions.title: Log Leave Notification Form Guide
versions.subtitle: Complete field reference, acceptable input values, and validation rules.
versions.purpose: Explains each input field inside the Leave Notification Form, required formats, acceptable values, and shortcut tools.

sections.title: Form Layout & Elements
sections.description: Fill in your Rank, Surname, Date Range, and Reason. Click 'Log Leave Notification' to complete.

screenshotPlaceholder.title: Log Leave Notification Form Detail
screenshotPlaceholder.description: Screenshot of the Leave Notification Form highlighting Rank dropdown, Surname text box, Date Pickers, Reason category selector, and Submit button.

fields.name: Rank
fields.purpose: Identifies your official NZCF rank.
fields.acceptableValues: CDT, LACDT, CDTCPL, CDTSGT, CDTFSGT, OFFCDT, PLTOFF, FGOFF, FLTLT, SQNLDR, MRS, CIV.
fields.unacceptableValues: Custom rank strings not in standard NZCF list.

fields.name: Surname
fields.purpose: Your official last name for roster tracking.
fields.acceptableValues: 1 to 50 characters (letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes e.g., 'Smith', 'MacDonald', 'Delos Santos').
fields.unacceptableValues: Empty strings, numeric-only strings, special characters like @ # $ % *.

fields.name: Start Date
fields.purpose: First day of your leave period.

fields.name: End Date
fields.purpose: Final day of your leave period.
fields.acceptableValues: Valid calendar date string (YYYY-MM-DD) on or after Start Date.
fields.unacceptableValues: End Date occurring before Start Date.

fields.name: Reason Category
fields.purpose: Primary categorization for leave logging.
fields.acceptableValues: Exams / Academic Study, Work Commitments, Family Holiday / Personal, Medical / Illness, School Camp / Activity, Other.

fields.name: Custom Reason Detail (if Other/Personal)
fields.purpose: Additional explanation when 'Other' or 'Private/Personal' is chosen.

bestPractices: Use the 'This Parade Night' or 'Next Parade Night' shortcut buttons to set parade night leave with a single click.
Click 'Clear Form' if you need to reset all fields.

versions.title: Admin Control Panel Guide
versions.subtitle: System administration, member accounts, security rules, and global configuration.
versions.purpose: The Admin Control Panel allows authorized System Administrators to manage user accounts, configure security IP rules, set operational variables (unit name, parade night, rank options), and inspect system audit logs.

sections.title: Screen Layout & Management Panels
sections.description: The panel is organized into four reorderable panels: Members, IP Whitelist & Blacklist Maintenance, Unit Configuration Settings, and System Audit Trail. Panels can be dragged to reorder or clicked to collapse.

sections.title: Executive Access & Role Hierarchy
sections.description: Accounts are granted specific executive roles: Admin (system access), Adjutant (portal dashboard), and Staff (email notification recipients). Minimum 1 active Admin is required at all times.

bestPractices: Keep at least two active Admin accounts configured to prevent lockout.
Review the System Audit Trail regularly for administrative and security activity.
Use short, recognizable unit names in Unit Configuration Settings.

versions.title: Members Roster & Accounts Guide
versions.subtitle: Creating, editing, disabling, and managing pre-approved staff and executive accounts.
versions.purpose: Manage pre-approved accounts for Adjutants, Staff, Managers, and System Admins. Ensure a minimum of 1 active Admin is maintained at all times.

sections.title: Account Fields & Controls
sections.description: Configure account credentials, roles, and status. Click 'Add New Member Account' to expand the registration form.

fields.name: Rank & Surname
fields.purpose: Identifies the member on the roster and in system activity logs.
fields.acceptableValues: Rank selected from dropdown, Surname (1-50 letters/spaces).

fields.name: Email Address
fields.purpose: Primary login email and recipient for leave notification alerts.

fields.name: Roles (Admin, Adjutant, Staff)
fields.purpose: Determines permission levels and dashboard access.
fields.acceptableValues: Any combination of Admin, Adjutant, or Staff toggles.

fields.name: Account Active Toggle
fields.purpose: Enables or disables system login for this account.
fields.acceptableValues: Active (enabled) or Inactive (disabled). Cannot disable only active Admin.

bestPractices: Test email delivery using the 'Send Test Email' button after registering new staff.
Disable accounts for departed personnel rather than deleting to preserve audit history.

versions.title: IP Whitelist & Blacklist Rules Guide
versions.subtitle: Managing IP access rules, auto-whitelisting, and automated 30-day expiration.
versions.purpose: Maintain IP security rules for the application. Admins are automatically whitelisted on successful login, and blacklisted IPs expire automatically after 30 days.

sections.title: Security Rules & Expiration
sections.description: Whitelist rules grant unrestricted access; Blacklist rules block access immediately. Blacklisted entries automatically expire after 30 days.

fields.name: IP Address
fields.purpose: Network IP target for rule evaluation.

fields.name: Type (Whitelist / Blacklist)
fields.purpose: Determines whether traffic from this IP is allowed or blocked.

versions.title: Unit Configuration Settings Guide
versions.subtitle: Global operational settings, unit name, parade night, rank dropdown options, and inactivity timeouts.
versions.purpose: Configure unit-wide variables that apply globally across all pages and components.

sections.title: Global Operational Variables
sections.description: Update settings to match your unit's structure. Changes take effect immediately site-wide.

fields.name: Unit Name
fields.purpose: Display name used in headers, page titles, and email dispatches.
fields.acceptableValues: Short text string (e.g. 29 Squadron, 29 SQN, TACCU, Chatham).

fields.name: Rank Options Dropdown
fields.purpose: Comma-separated list of ranks for dropdown selections, with quick preset buttons for Sea, Land, and Air Cadets.

fields.name: Unit Parade Night
fields.purpose: Day of the week personnel meet. Controls parade preset calculations.
fields.acceptableValues: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

fields.name: Logged in User Time-out
fields.purpose: Inactivity duration in seconds before automatic logout.

versions.title: System Audit Trail Guide
versions.subtitle: Chronological log of administrative actions, user activity, and security events.
versions.purpose: Inspect full audit history of leave creations, login attempts, IP rule changes, member edits, and setting updates.

sections.title: Audit Log Structure
sections.description: Logs record every critical system event, auto-trimmed to the last 30 days.

fields.name: Stamp
fields.purpose: NZ-formatted timestamp of the event.

fields.name: Action & Actor
fields.purpose: Classification of action and user/IP responsible.
fields.acceptableValues: Event type (e.g. LEAVE_CREATE, ADMIN_LOGIN_SUCCESS) and actor identity.

versions.title: Term Dates Guide
versions.subtitle: Configuring school/unit term start and end dates for Terms 1 through 4.
versions.purpose: Maintain official term date boundaries per academic year. Allows admins to configure T1, T2, T3, and T4 start and end dates.

sections.title: Yearly Term Configurations
sections.description: Click 'Add Year' to open the modal dialog and specify date boundaries for each term using the date pickers.

fields.name: Year
fields.purpose: Academic or operational year (e.g. 2026).

fields.name: Terms 1-4 Start & End Dates
fields.purpose: Date boundaries defining each term.
